scope: Actual visual review of supplied Apple PDFKit proofs for both final-r2 PDFs. All 56 pages in each appearance were viewed in whole-book contact sheets and again in native-size four-page sheets.
supersededEvidence: The earlier final r1 PDFs and proofs were superseded after a changelog source-link correction. They do not qualify this receipt. Every page was visually reviewed again from final-r2 proofs; no unchanged-role comparison is needed for acceptance.
pageNumbering: All page numbers in this receipt are physical one-based PDF pages. Page labels are recorded separately.
roleMapVerification: Verified role positions against both final-r2 maps and actual rendered pages. The cover strapline is not a prompt. The diagram on physical page 4 is vector content; Figure pages are identified by map text and raster paints.

contactSheet.reviewPurpose: Whole-book overview; native sheets provide page detail.
Whole-book overview; native sheets provide page detail.

observedQuality.assessment: Both covers clearly show version 2.1.2 and October 7, 2026. Contents, running heads, physical role positions and visible page labels agree with the maps. No unexpected blank or missing page was observed.

All six task-and-tool headers are readable and sit with their intact prompt bodies. The first five specify Claude Design; physical page 42 specifies Claude Code. Borders, fills, text contrast and margins remain legible in both appearances.

All nine opener titles, subtitles and illustrations fit within the page. Daytime grayscale art and Late night separately authored warm artwork are sharp; no distracting rectangular outer background or clipping was observed.

The workflow diagram is readable. Screenshots retain the original light application UI in both appearances. Figures and captions are separated and fit in their allotted areas; selected values and the cart actions remain visible. Existing screenshot crops do not appear to be PDF layout clipping.

Table headings, rows and column boundaries are readable. The page 32 to 33 continuation repeats its header and keeps rows intact. Individual native renders on physical pages 5 and 48 were checked to resolve apparent tight gutters in sheet views; the actual page renders show separated cells. No text overlap or page-edge clipping was observed.

References wrap cleanly with clear numbered markers. The final changelog shows the new prompt-label clarification, previous-edition links and the prior Daytime hash without clipping. The r2 corrected source-link page was reviewed anew.
The staged unavailable/image-error fixture caveats, separate recipient-runtime checks, static Figma continuation scope and lack of fresh Design-generation evidence remain legible.

limitations: This is a visual review of builder-supplied Apple PDFKit raster proofs, using the existing renders at 144 dpi. The reviewer did not rebuild or render any PDF.
This receipt covers Apple PDFKit proof quality only. It does not claim Poppler or hosted-reader QA; those are separate reviews.

Visual inspection does not establish native Claude Design generation, prototype interaction, runtime component reuse, Figma editability or prototype wiring. The handbook retains separate evidence limits for those claims.
No link was opened or clicked. Link destination correctness, network availability and public publication are not established by this visual receipt.
This is candidate QA, not release or publication authorization.
mutationBoundary: Only this QA JSON receipt was written; source, PDFs, renders, contact sheets and other outputs were preserved.
